approach.title: A repeatable method that keeps automation adopted
approach.subtitle: Five moves that keep adoption high
approach.description: Every program starts with evidence, co-design, and guardrails. The stages below show how strategy becomes an operating model teams actually keep running.

stages.title: Discover the real friction
stages.summary: Shadow workflows, baseline the metrics executives actually care about, and map the people who can champion the change.
proof: Baseline adoption and ROI metrics agreed with sponsors

stages.title: Design the operating rhythm
stages.summary: Co-create the future-state cadence, dashboards, and story that explains how the new operating model works before automation enters the picture.
proof: Annotated future-state flow mapped with owners
Communication kit drafted with change stories

stages.title: Pilot with instrumentation
stages.summary: Run controlled pilots with analytics and field coaching that surface adoption signals in real time.
proof: Pilot scorecard live within two weeks
Qualitative feedback loop hooked into weekly standups

stages.title: Automate with guardrails
stages.summary: Launch automation, dashboards, and governance together so every team inherits clear roles, alerts, and recovery plans.

stages.title: Sustain and evolve
stages.summary: Stand up enablement, champion networks, and improvement backlogs so the program keeps compounding value after launch.

signals: Week-over-week storytelling that ties ROI, adoption, and delivery health together.
Enablement tracks, office hours, and feedback loops that convert new processes into habits.
Executive scorecards plus champion networks that keep momentum visible long after launch.
